input_data_sources.finding: New-village branch reaches TerrainSelect when ValidateVillageSave is OFF; UIMapSelectHandling is followed by SaveSetFromUIResult(cVillage). EndCharacterMaking then checks the flag again: ON calls PV; OFF takes a message/WaitFrame path. PV's ON case requests cOpeningMovie, while its OFF case sets MakeVillagePlayerFlag and IsFirstPrologue.
NewGame runs SaveGrowUp(cStart) and requests stage cMainFieldDemoLanding.
UniqueID keys FieldData; the FieldData stem supplies the LandMaking resource name.
Example data join for UID 0 / FieldData FieldPresetA00; not identified as the runtime-selected option.

claim_matrix.claim: TerrainSelect invokes UIMapSelectHandling then saves a cVillage result.
The cVillage result index is copied into the four-entry context and can select an entry whose UID is written to MainFieldParamUniqueID.
claim_matrix.condition: The entry consumer runs only under its feature/status guards.

claim_matrix.claim: World setup can read that saved UID and load its matching FieldData_LandMaking resource.
claim_matrix.condition: Established from the shared SaveMainField field; the same-run invocation after the cVillage consumer is not established.

claim_matrix.claim: The visible card selected by the user maps to the exact UID loaded on the new-game world-init path.
Loaded LandMaking data alone establishes final collision/PBC, actor/model construction, and player spawn.

conclusion: The field-value bridge is established: cVillage index -> conditional entry[index] UID write at SaveMainField+0xcfa2a -> saved-UID consumer -> UID-keyed LandMaking resource loader. The lifecycle bridge from a particular MapSelect result to execution of that loader remains OPEN. The specific blockers are the UI action/page/callback ownership and card-to-entry order, the missing scheduling edge from the selected-entry consumer to 0x565e30, and the uncertain ValidateVillageSave query-to-handler edge. The randomized creator path is a separate proven caller and is not evidence for the user's selection.
